fields.mechanism: Temporal variation of soiling rate (dust accumulation rate changes over time) as captured by LSTM-based prediction.
fields.intervention: Implement an AI-driven predictive soiling model (CNN for image analysis + LSTM for temporal prediction) that forecasts weekly reflectance loss; when predicted loss approaches 2%, activate a dry cleaning mechanism (e.g., pulsed air jets) to remove dust without water, and optimize coating surface properties (e.g., hydrophobic texture) based on predicted soiling patterns.
fields.expected_effect: Reflectance loss kept under 2% weekly by proactive dry cleaning triggered by accurate predictions, avoiding water use and withstanding thermal cycles.
fields.falsification_test: In a desert test, run the AI model and dry cleaning for 1000 thermal cycles; measure weekly reflectance loss. If loss exceeds 2% or cleaning fails, the approach is falsified.
fields.mechanism_source_span: "a recurrent neural network (RNN) with a long, short term memory (LSTM) architecture predicts future soiling rates using the temporary variation in this parameter."

span_derivation.basis: shared content terms between span and mechanism+intervention; ratio < 0.20 = SPAN_UNDERIVED (the quoted span does not contain the mechanism's vocabulary)

prerequisite_evidence.basis: >=1 evidence item classified DIRECT_SUPPORT/PARTIAL_SUPPORT, or the candidate's span binding verified (R394 s5 classification + a2/verify)
